title: JustTPA
description: Lightweight TPA plugin featuring an admin settings GUI, combat logging protection, and teleport safety scans.
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88dc6e4c554bf909140aedde72b2e8016b540414.png)

   

### What is this plugin? JustTPA is a simple plugin for Minecraft servers that handles teleport requests. Instead of using huge, complicated plugins that take forever to set up, this is made to be fast and lightweight. It keeps the server running smoothly while giving players the commands they need to teleport safely. ### Key Features - Standard Commands: Includes /tpa to send a request, /tpahere to ask someone to come to you, and /tpaccept or /tpdeny to answer. - Safety Scanner: If a player tries to teleport to a dangerous spot, like lava, fire, or somewhere they would suffocate, the plugin will stop the teleport automatically. - Combat Blocker: Players cannot use teleport commands while they are fighting another player. This stops people from running away during a fight. - Anti-Cheat Delay: You can set a timer so players have to stand still for a few seconds before the teleport happens. If they move, it cancels automatically. - Admin Settings Menu: If you are an operator on the server, you can type /justtpasettings to open a menu. You can change the combat rules, safety scanner, or delay timers right from the game without needing to edit any files. ### How to Use It 1. Put the JustTPA.jar file into your server's plugins folder. 2. Restart the server. **The plugin will start working immediately.** ## Commands - **/tpa [player]**: Asks to teleport to a player. - **/tpahere [player]**: Asks a player to come to you. - **/tpaccept**: Accepts a request. - **/tpdeny**: Rejects a request. - **/justtpasettings**: Opens the settings menu. -Operators only
